functions.title: Objectives
content: Understand company and client challenges and how integrating Low-Code Development Platform capabilities can help create solutions.
Assist cross-functional teams to identify and prioritize key areas of the partner’s business where A Low-Code Development Platform and Big Data solutions can drive significant business benefit.
Analyze and explain Low-Code Development Platform and Big Data solutions while setting and maintaining high ethical standards.

functions.title: Responsibilities
content: Work on functional design, process design (including scenario design, flow mapping), prototyping, testing, training, and defining support procedures, working with an advanced engineering team and executive leadership.
Document and articulate solution architecture and lessons learned for each exploration and accelerated incubation.
Customize and manage integration tools, databases, and analytical systems.
Manage and structure data.
Serve as liaison between management and project teams, delivering feedback and enabling them to make necessary changes to product performance or presentation.

functions.title: Required Skills and Qualifications
content: Solid skill on MS SQL.
Knowledge of basic algorithms, object-oriented and functional design principles, and best practice patterns.
Experience in following web development languages is a plus: C#, JavaScript, HTML, DHTML, XML, etc.
Experience with program leadership, governance, and change enablement is a plus.
Strong interests in project management skills.
Good communication skills.
Ability to solve complex networking, data, and software issues.

functions.title: Preferred Qualifications
content: Bachelor or MS’s degree in MIS or Computer Science preferred.
Experience with Cloud environments.

functions.title: Objectives
content: Seeking Network Engineer to support in-house development and client site troubleshooting in Microsoft Windows Server and Cloud environments.

functions.title: Responsibilities
content: Day to Day Maintenance of a Windows AD Infrastructure and Microsoft Windows Server Platform.
Establishes networking environment by designing system configuration; directing system installation; defining, documenting, and enforcing system standards.
Design and configure AWS and Azure cloud environment and services to deliver resilient and reliable application infrastructure service to customers.
Maximizes network performance by monitoring performance; troubleshooting network problems and outages; scheduling upgrades; collaborating with network architects on network optimization.
Sets and supports Virtualization environments.
Sets and supports Microsoft SQL Server environments.
Plans and implements of database maintenance and recurring tasks with the SQL Scheduling service.
Performs client consultation: plan, design, documents, implement, and support LAN/WAN networks.
Plans and implements network security, including maintaining firewalls, developing VPN, remote solutions and maintaining company security policies.
Troubleshoot, maintain, upgrade, and provide solutions to complex hardware/software problems.

functions.title: Qualifications
content: Must be familiar with Windows Server environment, SQL Server, High Performance Cluster, TCP/IP networking desired and Virtualization environment.
2+ years of hands-on experience with server applications in a Microsoft networked environment and high level of Active Directory Management.
Familiar with AWS and Azure cloud services and infrastructures.
Expertise in the following areas: MS Windows Server, MS SQL Server, Recovery TCP/IP networking, LAN/WAN, Routing and Switching.
Excellent knowledge of server hardware and strong problem-solving skills.
Expertise with Data Backup and Disaster Recovery plan.
Solid programming and scripting abilities.
Project management and documentation skills.
High level of initiative and dedication.
Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Mathematics or a related discipline.
